headline: South African Reserve Bank Expresses Confidence in Returning Inflation to 3%
summary: The South African Reserve Bank stated it is confident that its current monetary policy settings will bring inflation back to its 3% target as the inflationary shocks from the Middle East conflict fade.
why: The South African Reserve Bank sets benchmark borrowing costs for Africa's most industrialized economy, directly impacting rand yields and sovereign debt pricing.

impacts.name: South Africa
impacts.why: Credible disinflation toward 3% creates room for future monetary easing and lower borrowing costs.
